stories.title: Warm and sunny bank holiday weekend forecast for Flintshire, with hotter weather to follow
stories.summary: A warm and settled bank holiday weekend is forecast for Flintshire, with temperatures set to peak at 25°C on bank holiday Monday before climbing further into next week. stories.title: Welsh Government confirms childcare expansion as Labour calls for funding clarity
stories.summary: The new Welsh Government has confirmed plans to phase in 20 hours of funded childcare per week for all children aged 9 months to 4 years across the Senedd term. stories.title: The Highway in Ewloe to close for four days next week as roundabout roadworks scheme

stories.title: More than 135,000 children in Wales estimated to have a diagnosable mental health condition

stories.title: UK inflation falls to 2.8% as energy bills drop but petrol prices hit four-year high
stories.summary: UK inflation fell to 2.8% in the year to April 2026, its lowest level since March 2025, official figures have shown. The Consumer Prices Index measure of inflation was down from 3.3% in the year to March, the Office for National Statistics said.
